$comment: The per-act hero atlases (ticket 451; TD shape 6226270701 '#451 shape'): one albedo-only KTX2 of 16 cells per act, its cells in the order docs/art/ore-heroes/hero-cells.json packs them per act (#452, tickets 744 and 785). P1 (foothold.base) and a P2 held under ore rules 5 or earlier (foothold.heavy) draw the legacy pool, so both acts hold its four heroes first; foothold.base then packs P1's three gems (ticket 785: Diamond, Emerald, Ruby), and foothold.heavy the three gems of a fresh P2's own pool (ticket 744: Star Garnet, Verdigris Opal, Aquamarine) and the nine gems of P3 to P5 (ticket 785), filling its 16 cells. An act with no row, and a hero with no cell, draws the shader look.
